Preview a demo survey in one line

Source: R/preview_demo.R
preview_demo.Rd

Loads a bundled demo with the standard branding and opens it as a respondent would see it, either as a standalone page in the browser or on SurveyStudio's preview screen. The preview has its collector removed, so trying it is safe.

Usage

preview_demo(
  name = "two_group",
  where = c("browser", "studio"),
  open = interactive()
)

Arguments

name

Character. The demo to preview. sframe_demos() lists them. Defaults to "two_group".

where

One of "browser", a standalone HTML page written by export_static_survey(), or "studio", the preview screen of launch_studio().

open

Logical. Whether to open the browser. Defaults to interactive().

Value

For "browser", the path of the HTML page, invisibly. For "studio", what launch_studio() returns.

See also

sframe_demo(), export_static_survey(), launch_studio()

Examples

path <- preview_demo("two_group", open = FALSE)
#> Static survey written to '/tmp/RtmpwBSeRG/surveyframe-preview-two_group.html' (72.7 KB).
file.exists(path)
#> [1] TRUE
